heard: Son of Jechoniah, the captain, heir of the royal blood, Chalchel, his name was given in the darkened time of God. Father of the governor, leading Judah's returning Zerubbabel, his name was known in the exile's ending Haggai spoke the Lord's command to the house that lay in ruin Timber bring to hill and field, let the temple be rebuilt Stirred the spirit of the man And the priest
